name: How much does interior trim installation typically cost?

mainEntity.name: How much does interior trim installation typically cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of trim installation depends primarily on linear footage, the material selected, and existing wall conditions. Installing simple baseboards or door casings costs less than intricate crown molding or custom multi-piece trim packages. Practical tradeoffs involve material choices: standard MDF is budget-friendly and paints smoothly, while solid wood costs more but offers greater durability against moisture and impact. Labor costs can also shift if existing trim removal, drywall patching, or uneven framing must be corrected before new boards sit flush. Abraham Becerra reviews these site conditions during initial walkthroughs to provide accurate, transparent estimates.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs depend on linear footage, material choice, and wall prep. Basic baseboards cost less, while intricate crown molding or repairs for uneven walls increase overall labor.
